observed_gap: v0.11.1 provides deterministic node-local traceability impact closure, but no artifact-authority freshness layer spans specifications, decisions, trace graphs, tasks, prompts, tests, manifests, dependency definitions, and release-authoritative artifacts.
hypothesis: An explicit artifact-provenance dependency graph keyed by stable artifact identity and content hash can deterministically compute exact affected/stale authority sets across the frozen MUST-07 mutation universe, while allowing safe reuse only when governed identity/provenance remains valid.

allowed: minimal CLI/API exposure required by the frozen evaluator
forbidden: changing existing traceability semantics except additive integration
inventing dependency edges from filenames or prose
changing frozen matrix, denominators, thresholds, or failure criteria after implementation begins

primary.name: mutation_outcome_exact_match_rate
primary.numerator: frozen cases whose affected set, stale-authority set, and safe-reuse decision exactly match expected

guardrails.name: provenance_completeness_rate
guardrails.denominator: all emitted affected/stale outputs across the 21 frozen cases

guardrails.name: parent_trace_impact_exact_match_rate
guardrails.denominator: all existing frozen v0.11.1 trace impact cases

failure_criteria: any of 21 frozen mutation cases differs from expected affected/stale/reuse outcome
any positive mutation permits stale promotion-authoritative reuse
any of 6 negative controls is falsely invalidated
missing provenance is treated as fresh or equivalent
any emitted affected/stale output lacks complete machine-readable source-mutation, dependency-path, and identity provenance
any repeat differs under identical inputs
any existing frozen trace-impact case changes
any of 25 active regressions fails or disappears
any frozen contract or matrix semantic identity changes after freeze
missing_data_policy: Missing, unreadable, unevaluated, or provenance-incomplete artifacts remain in their frozen denominator and are INCOMPLETE/STALE evidence; they never count as fresh, equivalent, zero defects, or PASS.
backward_compatibility: Existing traceability impact behavior remains authoritative for node-local graph impact. Freshness is additive and must not rewrite historical v0.11.1 evidence or parent semantics.
verification_boundary: Lane 4 independently recomputes frozen identities, all matrix outcomes and denominators, parent trace-impact cases, 166 parent tests, 25 active regressions, and exact candidate identity. Lane 2 cannot self-certify promotion.

freeze_projection.hypothesis: An explicit artifact-provenance dependency graph keyed by stable artifact identity and content hash can deterministically compute exact affected/stale authority sets across the frozen MUST-07 mutation universe, while allowing safe reuse only when governed identity/provenance remains valid.
